summaries.description: List of query shape statistic summaries from Query Shape Insights.

QueryStatsSummary.description: A summary of execution statistics for a given query shape.

avgWorkingMillis.description: Average total time in milliseconds spent running queries with the given query shape. If the query resulted in `getMore` commands, this metric includes the time spent processing the `getMore` requests. This metric does not include time spent waiting for the client.

bytesRead.description: The number of bytes read by the given query shape from the disk to the cache.

command.description: The MongoDB command issued for this query shape.

cpuTime.description: Total CPU time in nanoseconds consumed by queries with the given query shape. Available for MDB 8.2 and higher.

docsExamined.description: Total number of documents examined by queries with the given query shape.

docsExaminedRatio.description: Ratio of documents examined to documents returned by queries with the given query shape.

docsReturned.description: Total number of documents returned by queries with the given query shape.

execCount.description: Total number of times that queries with the given query shape have been executed.

keysExamined.description: Total number of in-bounds and out-of-bounds index keys examined by queries with the given query shape.

keysExaminedRatio.description: Ratio of in-bounds and out-of-bounds index keys examined to indexes containing documents returned by queries with the given query shape.

lastExecMicros.description: Execution runtime in microseconds for the most recent query with the given query shape.

namespace.description: Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`.

p50ExecMicros.description: The 50th percentile value of execution time in microseconds.

p90ExecMicros.description: The 90th percentile value of execution time in microseconds.

p99ExecMicros.description: The 99th percentile value of execution time in microseconds.

queryShape.description: A query shape is a set of specifications that group similar queries together. Specifications can include filters, sorts, projections, aggregation pipeline stages, a namespace, and others. Queries that have similar specifications have the same query shape.

queryShapeHash.description: A hexadecimal string that represents the hash of a MongoDB query shape.

systemQuery.description: Indicates whether this query shape represents a system-initiated query.

totalTimeToResponseMicros.description: Time in microseconds spent from the beginning of query processing to the first server response.

totalWorkingMillis.description: Total time in milliseconds spent running queries with the given query shape. If the query resulted in `getMore` commands, this metric includes the time spent processing the `getMore` requests. This metric does not include time spent waiting for the client.
